premise.observed_controller_defect: The prior owner routed every outcome through one finish helper that removed the experiment container and released the bench. A recoverable pre-science allocator exception therefore discarded the continuous claim instead of preserving the warm repair boundary.

allocator_repair_contract.required_source_behavior: Allocate and own the proxy logical-slot vector lazily for TARGET_VERIFY only; stock EXTEND, prefill, ordinary decode, model load, and CUDA-graph setup allocate no proxy vector or proxy bank.
required_allocator_tests: A stock EXTEND fixture proves zero proxy allocation and leaves allocator capacity unchanged.
A TARGET_VERIFY fixture allocates exactly its logical rows from the live batch-tree allocator and proves disjoint stock/proxy vectors.
Accepted and rejected TARGET_VERIFY rows move/free exactly once and ordinary post-accept decode remains stock.
The prior 8,192-slot exhaustion geometry is reproduced before the repair and passes after it.

recoverable_retained_repair: For an unconsumed, unclassified, or ordinary recoverable pre-science failure, persist a typed diagnostic and keep the bench claim.
If the server remains healthy, keep it and its resident checkpoint and caches.
If a process-start repair is required, prepare and hash-bind the replacement source first, then stop and replace only the experiment server or container under the same claim.
Heartbeat the claim and emit the existing repair-handshake ready state; do not invoke gpu_pool release.
terminal_cleanup_and_release: Cleanup and release are allowed only after an interpretable component or scientific result, an unsafe or unreachable guest, or the absolute lifecycle/release deadline.
The cleanup path must be explicitly selected from decision-bearing evidence and must persist its disposition before stopping the runtime or releasing the claim.

prohibited_structure: No generic finish, finally, trap, or shared outcome helper may both handle recoverable outcomes and remove the runtime or release the bench.
No recoverable, unconsumed, or unclassified default branch may run docker rm/stop or gpu_pool release.
required_owner_tests: A recoverable pre-science failure fixture proves zero runtime-removal calls and zero gpu_pool release calls while persisting repair-ready state.
An unclassified failure fixture defaults to the same retained-repair path.
A decision-bearing terminal fixture proves cleanup and release occur only after the disposition is persisted.
An absolute-deadline fixture proves cleanup and release remain available as the safety backstop.

pass_conditions: All four allocator tests and all four owner-disposition tests pass.
gpu_claimed and provider_contacted are false and additional_provider_spend_usd is 0.

readmission_gate: No claim clock opens until this amended terminal contract passes and a later director verifies the exact owner entrypoint, available bench, remaining reservation, and lifecycle window.
